_meta.label: synthetic - illustrative
_meta.confidentiality: Synthetic. No real TATA Motors telematics data or SPN/FMI dictionary is used or reproduced. Column names are the real ones so the pipeline can later run on a real export offline; only the values are invented.
_meta.cost_tat: ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders - that data is owned by another team.

normal_advisory.note: single unambiguous mapping -> ADVISORY with fix blocks

red_stop_lamp.note: Red stop lamp ON -> severity CRITICAL

ambiguous_key.note: one (SPN,FMI) mapped to P042E-00 and P042F-00 -> AMBIGUOUS_MAPPING_CANDIDATES

ambiguous_key_2.note: second ambiguous key -> P04A4-00 and P04A5-00

fmi_unmapped.note: SPN known, FMI 10 not mapped -> FALLBACK_CANDIDATES (never auto-advised)

unknown_spn.note: SPN not in the dictionary -> UNMAPPED, logged, no advisory

code_not_in_manual.note: maps to P0195-00, which this manual does not cover -> REFUSED_NOT_IN_MANUAL

low_byte_not_in_manual.note: maps to P0116-13; base P0116 exists, that low byte does not -> CLARIFY_LOW_BYTE

malformed_rows.note: 6 rows: 4 malformed ones are rejected on this vehicle's report, a 5th has an empty Vehicle_Id so it cannot be attributed to any vehicle and is counted in fleet_summary's rows_rejected, and the 6th is valid and still advises

transposition_P1000.note: telemetry -> P1000-00; a technician typing P0100-00 must be flagged MISMATCH with 'possible transposition'

transposition_P1675.note: telemetry -> P1675-00; a technician typing P1657-00 must be flagged MISMATCH with 'possible transposition'

severity_cap.note: no lamp but occurrence 9 / 240 min -> raised to HIGH, never CRITICAL

flashing_red_lamp.note: Flashing red stop lamp -> severity CRITICAL
